evals.prompt: This is a fresh Vite + React + TypeScript app (package.json has react, react-dom and vite; no i18n library yet). We decided on Nordbeam Locale. Set up i18n with English as the base and add French. The home page shows a greeting with the user's name, an item count like '0 items / 1 item / 12 items' and a language switcher.
evals.expected_output: The project is initialised with init --framework vite-react, English and French catalogs use ICU plural syntax, the App is wrapped in i18n.Provider and uses the generated typed messages, a switcher calls setLocale, and verify passes.
expectations: Installs nordbeam-locale (and @nordbeam/locale for the framework adapter) before running any npx nordbeam-locale command
Runs npx nordbeam-locale init --framework vite-react (or init with the framework detected as vite-react)
Adds nordbeamLocale() from nordbeam-locale/vite to vite.config.ts if the file already existed and was preserved
Writes the item count as an ICU plural message with an other branch, using # for the count
Creates messages/fr.json with the same argument names and a French plural (one and other branches at minimum) rather than copying English
Wraps the app in <i18n.Provider initialLocale="en"> imported from the scaffolded src/i18n/client and reads messages with i18n.useI18n()
Implements the switcher with setLocale from i18n.useI18n(), not hand-rolled state
Runs check --json and generate --json, and finishes by running verify --json with exit status 0
Does not edit any file listed in src/i18n/.nordbeam-locale-manifest.json

evals.prompt: In our Next.js 16 App Router app (already using Nordbeam Locale with en and de, app routes in src/app/[locale]) add a French locale and make sure the language switcher on the header can change the locale and keep the current page.
evals.expected_output: messages/fr.json is added with matching ICU contracts, routing includes fr, and the switcher uses createNextNavigation's usePathname and useRouter().replace(pathname, { locale }).
expectations: Reads nordbeam-locale.config.json or runs inspect --json to find the catalog directory and base locale
Creates the fr catalog in the configured catalog directory, with the same argument names and rich tags as the base messages
Runs generate and check --strict (or verify) and fixes any reported FALLBACK_MESSAGE or MISSING_MESSAGE rows by translating, not by copying English
Builds or reuses src/i18n/navigation.ts from createNextNavigation(routing) rather than importing next/link directly for locale links
Implements the switcher as a Client Component calling router.replace(pathname, { locale }) with pathname from the navigation usePathname()
Does not pass a messages object or message function from a Server Component to a Client Component props
Ensures the request file (proxy.ts or middleware.ts) sits beside src/app and the matcher is unchanged

evals.prompt: nordbeam-locale check keeps failing on my messages/fr.json and I don't get why. Can you fix it? (Running check --json shows INVALID_ICU with MISSING_OTHER_CLAUSE for 'items', UNKNOWN_ARGUMENT for 'greeting', and DROPPED_RICH_TAG for 'cart.terms'.)
evals.expected_output: Each diagnostic is fixed in the French catalog following the code's fix, then check and verify pass.
expectations: Uses the structured output (check --json) and reads code, file, line and fix instead of guessing
Runs explain on at least one code, or applies the fix text the diagnostic carries
Adds an other branch to the French plural and keeps # for the count
Restores the base message's argument name in the French greeting instead of renaming the argument in the base catalog
Restores the missing rich tag pair in the French cart.terms text
Re-runs check --json, generates, and finishes with verify --json exit status 0

evals.prompt: Add a 'Last seen {date} ({count, plural...})' style message to our Vue 3 + Nordbeam Locale app: it should say 'Last seen on Sep 10, 2026 by 3 people' with correct plural for people (1 person, 2 people), and use it in the profile component.
evals.expected_output: A catalog message combining a date and a plural, called through i18n.useI18n() messages in a Vue component with correct argument types.
expectations: Writes one ICU message using {date, date, medium} and a plural on the count with an other branch
Calls the message with a Date (or epoch number) and a number, not strings
In the Vue component uses i18n.useI18n() from the generated src/i18n/vue.ts and reads messages.value in script (or messages in the template), not a global import of the messages object
Adds the same message with the same arguments to every other locale catalog or leaves them as reported fallbacks and says so
Runs check --json, generate --json and verify --json

evals.prompt: Our Arabic translations were added to messages/ar.json but the item count message shows the wrong text for 2 and for 11 items. Look at it and fix it.
evals.expected_output: The Arabic plural has the categories Arabic requires (zero, one, two, few, many, other) with correct translations.
expectations: Recognises that Arabic needs more plural categories than English (zero, one, two, few, many, other)
Looks at the diagnostics (MISSING_PLURAL_CATEGORY or MISSING_PLURAL_BRANCH) via check --json or explain
Adds the missing branches while keeping # for the formatted count and the same argument name as the base message
Keeps the base English message unchanged
Ends with verify --json exit status 0 and does not hand-edit generated files

evals.prompt: I want to see where 'checkout.pay' is used and rename it to 'checkout.submit' across the catalogs and source, then make sure nothing is stale.
evals.expected_output: Uses inspect --id and rename --regenerate, reviews the diff, and verifies.
expectations: Runs inspect --id checkout.pay --json (or doctor) to see the message across locales before changing it
Uses the rename command with --id checkout.pay --to checkout.submit (and --regenerate or a following generate) instead of manual search and replace of catalogs
Reviews the git diff of catalogs and source afterwards and checks dynamic references that a static rename cannot see
Runs the project's type-check or build, then verify --json with exit status 0

evals.prompt: Our server component page imports the loaded messages and passes `messages` as a prop to a <Header /> client component, and it crashes with 'Functions cannot be passed directly to Client Components'. We use Nordbeam Locale in Next.js. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Only the locale string crosses the boundary; the client component reads messages through the client i18n provider.
expectations: Identifies that generated message functions are not serialisable across React Flight
Passes the validated locale string (not the messages object) to the client side
Wraps the client tree with NordbeamLocaleProvider or i18n.Provider from the scaffolded src/i18n/client or provider, and uses i18n.useI18n() in the client component
Does not convert the server page into a Client Component to work around the error

evals.prompt: Write a Node script that prints a localized order confirmation email subject in the user's locale. We use Nordbeam Locale (plain TypeScript, no framework). Locales are en and de; the locale arrives as a string from an HTTP header.
evals.expected_output: A script that validates the incoming locale against the generated locales, calls loadLocale per request, and uses a typed message.
expectations: Validates the header value against the generated locales list (for example locales.includes) before calling loadLocale
Falls back to the generated baseLocale when the value is unsupported
Imports from the generated index with the .js extension and awaits loadLocale(locale) per call instead of keeping a module-global current locale
Calls the message as a typed function, for example m.order.subject({ number }), after adding it to both en and de catalogs
Runs generate and verify --json
